heuristics.name: Unresolved Cross-Contract Calls
heuristics.description: Found calls to other contracts that could not be statically resolved to a specific target contract.
heuristics.falsePositiveNote: Dynamic dispatch (e.g. invoke_contract) or complex client wrappers often cannot be resolved statically.
